description: This file defines API routes for moderation features in a FastAPI application, including reported posts retrieval, post visibility updates, user status changes, and search functionality for posts and comments.

methods.name: get_reported_posts( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reported posts, ordered by creation date, for moderation.

methods.name: update_post_visibility( post_id: int, is_visible: bool, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the visibility status of a specific post, allowing publishing or unpublishing.

methods.name: update_user_status( user_id: int, is_active: bool, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Changes the active status of a user account, preventing self-deactivation.

methods.name: search_content( query: str, content_type: Optional[str] = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Searches for posts and comments matching a query string; requires admin access.
